title: STRENGTH A · SQUAT + PULL
emphasis: Baseline plan. Tell your coach what you actually completed.

ignition.name: Movement prep
ignition.prescription: 2 min easy rope or walk; 2 min hips/ankles/shoulders; 2 min unloaded rehearsal of today’s lifts.
ignition.home: 2 min easy rope or walk; 2 min hips/ankles/shoulders; 2 min unloaded rehearsal of today’s lifts.

deposits.title: SINGLE-LEG POWER

exercises.name: Dopa Band Side-Step Single Leg Drill
exercises.cue: Light resistance; fast clean entry, controlled reset. Stop when speed fades.
exercises.prescription: 3 crisp single-leg entries/side; reset fully between reps. No grind or fatigue circuit.
exercises.home: 3 crisp single-leg entries/side; reset fully between reps. No grind or fatigue circuit.

deposits.effort: Fresh, fast reps. Rest 90 sec after both sides.
deposits.label: A

deposits.title: BELT SQUAT

exercises.name: Belt Squat
exercises.prescription: 3 sets of 6–8. Choose a load leaving 2–3 good reps; record load.
exercises.home: 3 sets of 6–8. Choose a load leaving 2–3 good reps; record load.

deposits.effort: Leave 2–3 good reps in reserve. Rest is included in the timer.
deposits.label: B

deposits.title: PULL + CABLE PRESS

exercises.name: Strict Pull-Up
exercises.prescription: 5–8 clean pull-ups. Assistance if needed; no added load until confirmed.
exercises.home: 5–8 clean pull-ups. Assistance if needed; no added load until confirmed.

exercises.name: Split-Stance Single-Arm Cable Press
exercises.cue: Brace in split stance; keep ribs and pelvis facing forward.
exercises.away: Use the listed unloaded regression or comparable available equipment

deposits.effort: Leave 2–3 good reps in reserve. Rest is included in the timer.
deposits.label: C

exercises.name: Planche Lean
exercises.cue: Push the floor away. Stop before the shoulders or wrists lose position.
exercises.prescription: 15-sec easy planche lean; stop well before failure.
exercises.home: 15-sec easy planche lean; stop well before failure.

deposits.title: TRUNK + MOBILITY

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.cue: Do not let cable turn you

exercises.name: Cat-cow + quadruped rock-back
exercises.cue: Move gently with your breathing. Keep every position comfortable.
exercises.prescription: Alternate slow cat-cow and comfortable quadruped rock-backs. Split the allotted time equally. Pad knees or use a standing, hands-on-chair version if preferred.
exercises.home: Alternate slow cat-cow and comfortable quadruped rock-backs. Split the allotted time equally. Pad knees or use a standing, hands-on-chair version if preferred.
exercises.away: Use the same comfortable unloaded movements, with a wall or chair for support.

deposits.effort: Leave 2–3 good reps in reserve. Rest is included in the timer.
deposits.label: E

martialSupplement.name: DUMMY LAB · TOP-POSITION CONTROL
martialSupplement.home: Review a familiar stable top position with the dummy. Pause to inspect base and points of contact; reset gently and compare. Study only, without hard pressure or submission finishing. Focus: Can I explain which contacts keep the position stable while I move?
martialSupplement.away: Visualize the same familiar positions and write one question.
martialSupplement.cue: Weekly question: can I keep posture and connection consistent while changing position?
martialSupplement.text: Optional 7 min slow technical study. Record one discovery. Not conditioning.
